capabilities: Show the reading time of the note or selection in the status bar
Show time left and a progress bar while scrolling in Reading view or the editor
Skip front matter, comments, code blocks, math and link addresses when counting
Count Chinese, Japanese and Korean by character instead of words
Save reading time to a note property via commands
extras: On first run it copies settings from the older Reading Time plugin; running both plugins shows two status bar entries, so the old one should be turned off. Properties are only written when a command is run, never automatically.
intentEvidence: This plugin does what Reading Time does and adds selections, reading view, Chinese, Japanese and Korean
problem: Obsidian's word count shows only words and no reading time, and it does not handle selection-based estimates, CJK text or skipped elements like code and front matter.
